root_text:
A respiratory illness is raising alarms in China, five years after Covid-19. It has no vaccine, and the symptoms are similar to flu. Is the world ready for another virus outbreak in 2025? 🥹 

#HMPV #Pandemic2025 #alterphiliphines #alteriloi
